description: Lists every webhook on your account, newest first.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Send it with the same params as the first page (`limit` may change); a page whose params differ is a 400 naming the param.

status.description: Filter by status: `active`, `disabled` or both as a comma list. A webhook is always one of the two (`disabled` covers a user pause, the automatic disable after deliveries have kept failing for 72 hours with none getting through, and the automatic disable of a trigger that cannot run; `disabled_reason` on each record says which: `user_disabled`, `delivery_failure`, `evaluation_failure`, `plan_downgrade` or `subscription_canceled`). Omit for all. Values: active, disabled.

name: tickerbot_list_webhooks
